reverse_engineering.method: Rizin 0.9.1 analysis, cross references and function disassembly
reverse_engineering.observations: Builds paths to the bundled Python executable and scripts, starts a child with pipes, and consumes its output. IsDebuggerPresent is in runtime exception/failure handling.

The cmd.exe call checks file existence and redirects an empty command into a file. Other reviewed routines read machine identity registry values and establish a connection. Embedded protocol schemas describe licensing, authentication, projects and file storage; these supply application context rather than proof of credential theft.

Reviewed process-launch, ShellExecute, registry and WinHTTP cross references. Help actions name AGTEK help pages; map code references Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Mapbox and USGS. Python helpers handle the application's document and image workflow.
Rizin disassembly of the Python worker launcher and references to AgTiler.pyc and AgTiffTranslate.pyc. Native exception-directory function ranges were used when whole-image analysis timed out.

Disassembled all three direct CreateProcessA callers found by checking RIP-relative IAT calls against the exception directory. The image includes the local Python worker, generic command launch helpers, photogrammetry and OpenCV code, cloud sign-in URLs, and references to GNSS, calibration, tiling and orthophoto scripts.

reverse_engineering.method: Rizin bytecode disassembly plus CPython 3.11 marshal/dis, without executing code objects
